About the Practice

ColumbiaDoctors is the faculty medical practice of Columbia University Irving Medical Center, offering comprehensive interdisciplinary care in more than 230 specialties and subspecialties. [6, 7, 8] Comprised of over 1,800 highly regarded physicians, surgeons, dentists, and nurses, the practice provides patient care informed by cutting-edge research and delivered by elite healthcare providers. [6, 7, 10] Affiliated with NewYork-Presbyterian, ColumbiaDoctors offers seamless access to highly qualified professionals in virtually every medical and dental specialty, providing both advanced treatments, such as robotic surgical techniques, and traditional personalized care. [6, 7] Services are available at numerous locations throughout the New York metropolitan area, with on-site laboratory services and procedure facilities at many sites to enhance patient convenience and efficiency. [6, 7, 8, 13]

Research Analysis
Methodology & Findings

ColumbiaDoctors utilizes a patient portal branded as "Connect". This patient portal allows patients to manage appointments, communicate with providers, access test results, request prescription refills, and view and pay bills. The Connect patient portal is integrated with the Epic electronic health record (EHR) system. Columbia University Irving Medical Center, NewYork-Presbyterian, and Weill Cornell Medicine transitioned to the Epic EHR system and the Connect patient portal on February 1, 2020. Connect serves as a unified portal for these three institutions.
